name: Mabwell (Shanghai) Bioscience Co., Ltd.
summary: Mabwell (Shanghai) Bioscience Co., Ltd. is a biopharmaceutical company covering research, manufacturing and commercialisation of biologics for cancer, immune, bone, eye, blood and infectious conditions, in China and abroad. Its marketed products include MAIWEIJIAN for giant cell tumor of bone and MALISHU for postmenopausal osteoporosis.
